intro.title: How RESYNE can help you
intro.description: RESYNE is a team specialized in developing custom Artificial Intelligence solutions and management software for tourism. We support hotels, B&Bs, tour operators, and accommodation facilities in transforming business processes into automated, intelligent, and integrated systems.

solutions.subtitle: We develop and integrate tools that make tourism management more efficient, automated, and data-driven

management.title: Management systems and integrated solutions
management.description: Customized platforms for managing bookings, customers, payments, inventory, and staff. Cloud solutions and centralized dashboards to control every operational aspect in real-time.

ai.title: AI and intelligent automation
ai.description: Artificial intelligence systems to analyze reviews, demand flows, performance data, and guest behaviors. Automation for check-in, pre/post-stay communications, and multilingual customer responses.

booking.title: Booking and process optimization
booking.description: Smart booking engines, integrations with OTA portals, and dynamic pricing tools that adapt rates based on seasonality and market trends.

experiences.title: Digital experiences and sustainability
experiences.description: Solutions to enhance visitor experience with augmented reality, digital paths, and immersive storytelling. Technologies that promote more conscious energy and environmental management.

eligibility.registered: Companies regularly registered in the Business Register
eligibility.location: With operational headquarters in the province of Salerno
eligibility.sectors: Active in sectors: passenger transport, accommodation services, tour operators, travel agencies, beach resorts, and spa centers

funding.bonus: +€250 bonus for companies with legality rating

digital.description: Management software for bookings, customers, payments, and inventory. Digital systems to automate check-in, bookings, or orders.
digital.resyne: RESYNE creates custom cloud solutions to digitize every operational process and improve team productivity.

ai.title: Artificial Intelligence and Data Analysis
ai.description: AI to analyze reviews, behaviors, and tourist flows. Multilingual chatbots and virtual assistants. Predictive analysis for prices, seasonality, and availability.
ai.resyne: RESYNE develops predictive AI models and analysis dashboards integrated with your booking systems.

experiences.title: Digital Experiences for Visitors
experiences.description: Augmented and virtual reality for immersive visits. Interactive apps and kiosks with cultural or thematic paths. Solutions for accessibility and experience personalization.
experiences.resyne: RESYNE designs digital experiences and interactive tools that enrich the tourism offer.

security.title: Security and Data Management
security.description: Secure backup and cloud. Protection from cyber attacks. Staff training and digital risk management.
security.resyne: RESYNE integrates security systems and GDPR compliance to ensure maximum data protection.

integrated.title: Integrated Management of Tourism Supply Chain
integrated.description: Shared platforms between hotels, cultural operators, and local producers. Coordination of logistics, supplies, and integrated bookings. Digital tools for tourism business networks.
